key_insight: Molmo2 provides an open-weight, fully documented vision-language model trained on openly released data and recipes, achieving strong video understanding and explicit spatial-temporal grounding without relying on proprietary models or synthetic distillation.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the lack of fully open, reproducible foundations for state-of-the-art video-language models that also support grounding (spatial and temporal localization). It removes barriers caused by proprietary weights, undisclosed data, or distillation from closed models.
method: Release of model weights, training recipe, and a curated, fully documented open dataset for image- and video-language training (no proprietary distillation).
Architectural extensions for video: spatio-temporal encoder + cross-modal grounding head to predict bounding boxes and temporal spans alongside captioning/QA.
Multi-task training on combined objectives (contrastive alignment, captioning, temporal localization, spatial grounding) to unify high-level understanding with precise grounding capabilities.
impact: Molmo2 democratizes research by providing a reproducible, open baseline for video-language and grounding tasks, enabling practitioners to build, evaluate, and improve grounded VLMs without proprietary dependencies. This accelerates development of applications that need precise spatial/temporal reasoning (e.g., robotics, video QA, visual search).

paper_title: Molmo2: Open Weights and Data for Vision-Language Models with Video Understanding and Grounding
paper_authors: Christopher Clark, Jieyu Zhang, Zixian Ma, Jae Sung Park, Mohammadreza Salehi
